parameter_set.description: Two-hour Kubernetes, Slurm, and Ray demonstration with 45 MW and 90 MW bursts starting at t=30 s and t=310 s, followed by bursts at t=920 s, t=1850 s, and t=2700 s. Burst durations are 240 s, 300 s, and 600 s for the final three bursts, so workloads do not overlap. Two gas turbines are spinning at 35% minimum stable load from t=0; two more start from hot standby at Burst-02 and the grid-forming BESS bridges their startup gap. GE assumptions: 300-second hot start, 360-second warm start, 600-second cold start, and 30 MW/min ramp. Diesel delta_t_start_s revised 3600 → 10 s on 2026-10-21 (DR-2026-10-20-ISLAND-COLLAPSE D9c; NFPA 110 Type 10; PROPOSED_HERE).
parameter_set.name: 01 Turbine Scenario with Kubernetes Slurm Ray

operating_cost_inputs.diesel_price_usd_per_gal_provenance: CITED: EIA U.S. on-highway No. 2 diesel retail, week of 2026-10-19, $6.276/gal, including taxes (https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/gasdiesel/). Off-road generator fuel may exclude road taxes.
operating_cost_inputs.gas_price_basis_provenance: CITED: EIA heat-content conversion above; price is recorded on an HHV basis.
operating_cost_inputs.gas_price_usd_per_mmbtu_provenance: CITED: EIA U.S. Natural Gas Industrial Price, Aug 2025–Jul 2026 12-month mean $5.331/Mcf (https://www.eia.gov/dnav/ng/hist/n3035us3m.htm), divided by EIA 2025 average heat content 1,037 Btu/cf = 1.037 MMBtu/Mcf (https://www.eia.gov/tools/faqs/faq.php?id=45&t=5).
operating_cost_inputs.turbine_fixed_om_usd_per_kw_yr_provenanc: CITED proxy: EIA AEO2025 Capital Cost and Performance Characteristics, Table 1-2, Case 3, simple-cycle aeroderivative CTs, 4 × 54 MW; $9.56/kW-year, 2023 dollars; proxy for larger aeroderivative units.
